Description
The University of Cumbria is a modern public university in the UK, officially established in 2007. It has campuses in Carlisle, Lancaster, Ambleside, Barrow-in-Furness, Workington, and London, offering a unique blend of urban and scenic settings — including the stunning Lake District.
Known for its practical and career-focused education, the university offers programs in areas like education, health, business, arts, science, and outdoor studies. It serves over 10,000 students, including around 1,000 international students from across the globe.
With a strong emphasis on employability and community engagement, the University of Cumbria is a welcoming and supportive environment for students seeking both academic and real-world skills.
